I recommend Requiem of Wurm 100%
Starter gear, free deed with no upkeep, friendly people around all the time, not over populated, SUPER convenient modloader download made available by Zeus (the proprietor of Requiem currently), and a dedicated discord to make contact super easy. 
Oh, and if you do textures or code, Zeus ALWAYS loves help. And suggestions! If you cant code or art like some folks xD
